reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. Public API 'granted so that developers can share our jobs further': do NOT submit Remotive jobs to third-party job sites (Jooble, Neuvoo, Google Jobs, LinkedIn Jobs…), link back to the Remotive URL and name Remotive as the source or access is terminated; jobs are delayed 24 h; using the jobs to collect sign-ups / e-mails is a breach; fetch at most ~4 times a day. A private paid API exists (hello@remotive.com). robots.txt disallows /api/* for crawlers and /job/apply/*.

search.note: Keyless public API. Only limit is documented (no page parameter), so page > 1 repeats the same result set. Terms: link back to the Remotive URL and name Remotive as the source, never re-post the jobs to other job sites, and 'fetch at most ~4 times a day' (the client-side limiter allows one call per 100 s); listings are delayed 24 h. salary is a free-text string, left in raw.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none') and no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: Only the list endpoint and '/api/remote-jobs/categories' are documented; re-read the record from the search hit.
not_offered.apply: Page: 'apply stays assist (url → Remotive → employer)'; robots.txt disallows /job/apply/*.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the page documents job search and categories only.
